author: NASDAQ.com News
title: Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite Index closes above 8000; up 51.6 points at 8,041.97
text:
Shutterstock photo Thursday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index up above 8000 points. The index first reached the 8000 mark on Aug 27, 2018. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.03 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 1.01 to 1 ratio. There were 1526 advancers and 1510 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 35 stocks reached a 52 week high and 38 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed up .88% for the day; a total of 66.48 points. The current value is 7,629.57. Dollar Tree, Inc. ( DLTR ) had the largest percent change down (-2.7%) while Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ( REGN ) had the largest percent change gain rising 3.7%.
The Dow Jones index closed up .21% for the day; a total of 54.65 points. The current value is 26,439.93. DowDuPont Inc. ( DWDP ) had the largest percent change down (-2.33%) while Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change gain rising 2.06%.
